title: Small Datasets not working?
body:
I found some more serious, breaking issues with the slider in V2.

To demonstrate them I wanted to create a small subset but this only works with the search box but not the refinement list or more than one slider.

Taking the full dataset (6000+ entries) is no problem besides the problems with the slider.

So is there a minimum number of data points that instantsearch needs to work?

https://jsfiddle.net/bjav561j/
